speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are a pregnant patient experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To determine the cause, how many weeks pregnant are you, and did you travel to an area with mosquito or tick exposure recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Listeriosis (Maternal Infection)

Based on your consumption of potentially contaminated soft cheeses or deli meats (often associated with ice cream if unpasteurized or adulterated) 3 days prior to symptom onset, combined with your pregnancy status, this clinical picture is highly suggestive of Listeria monocytogenes infection. Have you consumed unpasteurized dairy products or deli meats recently?
